title: Layout-Aware PDF to DOCX Export 2.0
acceptance: Selected PDF pages reconstruct into editable Word paragraphs with source-informed ordering.
Qualified detected tables become editable Word tables and their text is not duplicated as ordinary paragraphs.
Qualified image regions are embedded as separate DOCX media objects rather than flattening the whole page.
Supported font name, size, weight, style, color, paragraph alignment, RTL flag, margins and page geometry are represented in OOXML.
Ambiguous multi-column order, skipped complex tables/images and omitted vector/nested artwork are disclosed.
Scanned pages without selectable/OCR text fail with the existing OCR-first guidance.
The conversion path uses no network or remote Office service.
Executable version and persistent formats remain unchanged.
